label: DUPLEXLS — dual duplex lift station
notes: DUPLEXLS: slot1 D1608E X1_I1=OFF X1_I2=LEAD X1_I3=LAG X1_I4=HIGH … X1_I10=gen; base analog in 1–6 (I1–I6 terminals, I1_RAW–I6_RAW) 0–1 V CTs→AI1–AI6 scaled 0–50 A; base R1/R2 contactors; slot2 A0602 8× 2-wire PT100 RTD on X2_AI1–X2_AI8 (MOTOR1/2_TEMP + RTD3–8 spare). Opta /setup: slot1=AFX00005 slot2=AFX00007, enable A0602 RTD checkbox. Opta firmware 2.3.73+ publishes MCSA-lite cooked spectra on mcsa[] (6 CT channels) plus edgeAi on pump starts — see st/fixtures/opta-mcsa-lite-telemetry-sample.json.
